item.title: Is RentAHuman the Future of Labor?
item.description: We know AI is replacing jobs. Ian asks what happens when AI systems start hiring people to do the kind of work they can’t do themselves?

item.title: The One Factor Holding Your Account Back
item.description: You’re so close to consistent trading gains. There’s only one thing holding you back… I see it every day: The opening bell rings. The coffee’s hot. The spikes are hotter. There’s face-ripping volatility in the market (especially right now). You’re ready.

item.title: The War in Iran: Stocks I’m Watching
item.description: Over the weekend, the U.S. and Israel launched strikes on Iran. War is ugly. And I hope this one ends quickly. But as traders, we can’t ignore the obvious volatility created by global conflict. Especially in oil-rich areas of the world… The first bombs dropped on Saturday. item.title: Why AI Needs Its Own Money
item.description: Ian explains why AI will legitimize stablecoins as the payment system that the next version of the internet actually needs.

item.title: The Only Job Security in an AI Economy
item.description: Jack Dorsey, co-founder of Twitter and Block, Inc. (formerly Square, Inc.), just fired 40% of his workforce. That’s 4,000 employees. Gone. And you’re running out of time to avoid the same fate… His explanation? “Our business is strong.” Why cut 4,000 people if the business is thriving? It’s simple … AI does their jobs now.

item.title: Chart of the Week: AI Is Reshaping the Labor Market
item.description: Ian says if you want to see how AI is changing work, you just need to look at the hiring data. Today's chart reveals AI's shocking impact.

item.title: While Everyone Panics, Traders Profit
item.description: An Iranian drone hit a residential building in Dubai on Sunday morning. Thankfully, it failed to detonate. Because I literally had an Airbnb booked nearby starting Monday. This is real, people. The Middle East is a battle zone. The markets are rattled. But my AI doesn’t even know there’s a war going on…

item.title: The Data Revolution in DNA
item.description: The compounding power of Moore's Law allowed for the internet the smartphone and AI. Now Ian says it's being applied to the human genome.

item.title: The Strongest Catalyst in the History of the Market
item.description: We’re in the first few days of an escalating war in Iran… The UAE defence ministry says it’s responding to more Iranian missile and drone threats. Explosions were reported in Qatar and Bahrain. Azerbaijan says it’s preparing “retaliatory measures” after being attacked by two Iranian drones. UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer says he will send four fighter jets to Qatar to strengthen defensive operations. Trump himself said the war could last weeks.

item.title: The AI Race Is Becoming a Power Race
item.description: Ian explains why AI companies are no longer assuming that the power grid will keep up and what they are doing about it.
